note: St. Joseph County Parks campground on 32-acre Cade Lake (RV Life mis-tags it commercial; it is county-operated). About 43 full-hookup sites and 9 rustic sites plus cabins; nightly sites alongside seasonal leases. Bookable from Feb 1. GPS may lead big rigs onto narrow back roads; the county says to approach via US 12. --Claude
summary: County page (c) 2026: full hookup $40 (confirmed; rustic $30 left out), cabins $75/$100, seasonal $2,300 + metered electric; camp store; booked by phone (May-Oct park office, otherwise main office). Season confirmed seasonal with the stated span (first Friday of May - Sunday before Columbus Day) added as a note. Water/sewer confirmed. Site count 62 (derived) and the seasonal share not stated by the county; left. Added the county's RV-access warning to the note; dropped prices, phone-booking and season text the fields now hold.
flags: Seasonal share not stated: the county rents seasonal sites ($2,300/season, applications by April 1) besides nightly full-hookup and rustic sites, but publishes no counts.
Access: the county warns 'RV Access Notice: GPS may lead you to narrow back roads. Approach via US 12 for the easiest maneuverability with large campers and trailers.'
